json-url.name: Value from a link
json-url.description: One value from any web link that gives JSON, such as your NAS, router or smart home. It lights up the notch when the value needs attention. You can add more than one.
json-url.privacy: Atap downloads the link you give it, as often as you choose and never more than once a minute. A sign-in header stays locked on this PC, and replies fetched with one stay in memory only.
json-url.urlHint: The web address that gives the data, such as http://192.168.1.10/api/status. Plain http works only for addresses on your home network.
json-url.title: Name on the notch
json-url.titleHint: Leave it empty to use the site's name.
json-url.pathHint: Where the value sits in the reply, such as data.temperature or items[0].name. Leave it empty to use the whole reply. Test shows the reply so you can find it.
json-url.maxHint: The value that fills the bar.
json-url.alerts: Light up the notch when it needs attention
json-url.alertsHint: For numbers. The notch shows the value while it is past your warning level.
json-url.badSide: It needs attention when it is
json-url.testHint: Fetches the link now with these settings and shows what the notch will show.
json-url.testIdle: Press Test to try the link now.
json-url.testOk: It works. This is what the notch will show.
json-url.testNoValue: The link works, but the value needs a fix. Check Value to show against the reply below.
json-url.testStale: The link did not answer just now. This is the last reply Atap had.
json-url.itemLabelHint: Where each item's name sits, such as name. Leave it empty to use the item itself.
json-url.itemValueHint: Where each item's value sits, such as status. Leave it empty to show names only.
json-url.headerHint: Only if the site needs one. Write it as Name: value, such as Authorization: Bearer abc123. Atap keeps it locked on this PC.
json-url.noLink: Add a link in this widget's settings.
json-url.failed: Could not reach the link. Check it and your connection.
json-url.offline: You are offline. Atap tries again when you are back.
json-url.blocked: Atap cannot open this link. Plain http works only for addresses on your home network.
json-url.tooLarge: The reply is too large. Atap reads up to 256 KB.
json-url.refused: The site said no. Check the link and the sign-in header.
json-url.problem.path: Value to show is not written right. Try something like data.temperature.
json-url.problem.itemPath: The name or value of each item is not written right. Try something like name.
json-url.problem.range: Full bar at must be above 0.
json-url.problem.thresholds: Critical at must be past Warning at.
json-url.problem.header: The sign-in header must be written as Name: value.
json-url.problem.headerMissing: The sign-in header was saved on another PC. Enter it again here.
